name: SPIRAL Connector for Contact Form 7
author: SPIRAL Inc.

sections.description:
“SPIRAL Connector for Contact Form 7″はContact Form 7 と SPIRAL を連携し、フォームから送信されたデータをSPIRALのデータベースへ保存し、SPIRALからメール送信します。

プラグインの特長
・Contact Form 7 を通じて登録されたデータは SPIRAL に安全に保存・管理されます。
・登録情報は SPIRAL 上でリアルタイムに閲覧・更新が可能です。
・フォームのメール送信先へは、DKIM、DMARC、オプトアウトに対応したSPIRAL からメール送信するため、Google、Yahooなどガイドラインが厳しいプロバイダーへもメールが届きやすくなります。
・Contact Form 7 と SPIRAL の連携は簡単に行え、フォーム項目の追加・調整も柔軟に対応できるため、用途に応じたカスタマイズが可能です。

プラグインの設定方法やショートコード情報などはサポートサイトを参照してください。
※SPIRALは スパイラル株式会社 の登録商標です。

このプラグインは会員管理機能を提供するために第三者（外部）サービスを利用しています。
プラグインの利用には SPIRAL ver.2 の申込が必要です。
・SPIRAL ver.2とは
Webサイトや業務アプリの作成ができるローコード開発プラットフォームです。
基本機能でのカスタマイズはもちろんのこと、ソース編集やプログラムを追加して、より目的にフィットしたサイトやアプリを手に入れられます。
金融機関や官公庁でも採用された最高レベルのセキュリティに守られながら、ローコード開発ならではのスピード開発を実現できます。
・SPIRALの開発環境を無料で提供しておりますので、SPIRALのご契約がない方は こちら より申請ください。
・お問い合わせは こちら

“SPIRAL Connector for Contact Form 7” is a WordPress plugin that integrates Contact Form 7 with SPIRAL, allowing submitted data and emails to be securely stored and delivered via SPIRAL.

Plugin Features:
– Form submissions through Contact Form 7 are safely stored and managed in SPIRAL
– Submitted data can be viewed and updated in real time within SPIRAL
– Emails sent to addresses collected via the form are delivered safely and efficiently using SPIRAL, with improved deliverability compared to WordPress’s default email functions
– Integration between Contact Form 7 and SPIRAL is easy, and form fields can be flexibly added or adjusted to meet your specific needs

For setup instructions and shortcode usage, please refer to the support site.
※SPIRAL is a registered trademark of SPIRAL Inc.

This plugin uses a third-party (external) service to provide membership management functions.
A separate contract for SPIRAL ver.2 is required to use the plugin.
– About SPIRAL ver.2
SPIRAL ver.2 is a low-code development platform that enables the creation of websites and business applications.
In addition to flexible customization through its standard features, users can modify source code and add programs to create sites and apps tailored to their specific needs.
With top-level security—trusted by financial institutions and government agencies—it empowers rapid development that only low-code environments can offer.
– SPIRAL’s development environment is available free of charge. If you do not currently have a SPIRAL contract, you can apply here.
– For inquiries, please contact us.

Service Provider: SPIRAL Platform

  • Service URL: SPIRAL ver.2
  • Terms of Use: SPIRAL ver.2 Terms of Use

Usage Details

This plugin uses the SPIRAL API to enhance its features. The API requests are made to the following endpoints:

API Endpoint:
– https://api.spiral-platform.com/v1/apps/ (application retrieval)
– https://api.spiral-platform.com/v1/apps/{appid} (application information)
– https://api.spiral-platform.com/v1/apps/{appid}/dbs/ (database creation and list)
– https://api.spiral-platform.com/v1/apps/{appid}/dbs/{dbid} (database update and information)
– https://api.spiral-platform.com/v1/apps/{appid}/dbs/{dbid}/records (form submission data storage)
– https://api.spiral-platform.com/v1/apps/{appid}/dbs/{dbid}/express/email (email sending)

API Endpoint engineerβ:
– https://api.beta.spiral-platform.net/v1/apps/ (application retrieval)
– https://api.beta.spiral-platform.net/v1/apps/{appid} (application information)
– https://api.beta.spiral-platform.net/v1/apps/{appid}/dbs/ (database creation and list)
– https://api.beta.spiral-platform.net/v1/apps/{appid}/dbs/{dbid} (database update and information)
– https://api.beta.spiral-platform.net/v1/apps/{appid}/dbs/{dbid}/records (form submission data storage)
– https://api.beta.spiral-platform.net/v1/apps/{appid}/dbs/{dbid}/express/email (email sending)

You can review the service URLs and terms of use related to these services at the following links:

  • Service URL: SPIRAL ver.2
  • Terms of Use: SPIRAL ver.2 Terms of Use
  • Privacy Policy: © SPIRAL Inc.

Please note that by using this plugin, you acknowledge and agree to the terms of use and privacy policy of SPIRAL.
Make sure to review them to ensure compliance and understanding of how your data is handled.

Privacy Policy

SPIRAL Connector for Contact Form 7 is a WordPress plugin that integrates Contact Form 7 with SPIRAL, enabling secure management and delivery of submitted form data and emails via SPIRAL.
Data submitted through Contact Form 7 is safely stored and managed within SPIRAL.
The submitted information is managed directly by the customer who controls the relevant SPIRAL account.
SPIRAL Inc. processes the data securely, without anyone viewing or tampering with it at any stage.
If you have any questions regarding privacy, please feel free to contact us.

This plugin utilizes third-party (external) services to provide membership management functionality.
To use the plugin, a separate contract with SPIRAL ver.2 is required.
You can review the service URLs and terms of use related to these services at the following links:

  • Service URL: SPIRAL ver.2
  • Terms of Use: SPIRAL ver.2 Terms of Use
  • Privacy Policy: © SPIRAL Inc.
sections.installation:
Install “SPIRAL Connector for Contact Form 7” automatically from your WordPress Dashboard by selecting “Plugins” and then “Add New” from the sidebar menu. Search for “SPIRAL Connector for Contact Form 7”, and then choose “Install Now”.

Or:

  1. Upload spiral-connector-for-contact-form-7.zip to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress
